body:
WHAT
`npm run dist` bundles the engine with rg.exe and runs electron-builder for Windows, producing a portable executable MAGENTRA-<version>-win-portable.exe and an NSIS installer MAGENTRA-<version>-win-setup.exe (non-one-click, directory choosable). The installer script adds a `magentra` terminal command (bin\magentra.cmd) to the user PATH and removes it on uninstall.

WHY
A Windows package without rg.exe ships a broken Grep tool, and the updater and release workflow depend on these exact artifact names.

WHERE
app/package.json — scripts.dist ('bundle-engine.js --target win && dist.js --win'), build.win.target ["portable", "nsis"], build.win.extraResources filter including "rg.exe", build.portable.artifactName "MAGENTRA-${version}-win-portable.exe", build.nsis { artifactName "MAGENTRA-${version}-win-setup.exe", oneClick false, allowToChangeInstallationDirectory true, include "build/installer.nsh" }. app/scripts/dist.js — spawnSync electron-builder with --publish never and -c.electronVersion. app/scripts/bundle-engine.js — RIPGREP entry { target: "win", src: node_modules/@vscode/ripgrep-win32-x64/bin/rg.exe } and the --target failure. app/build/installer.nsh — macros customInstall (CreateDirectory $INSTDIR\bin, File magentra.cmd, HKCU Environment Path append via magentraStrLoc) and customUnInstall (reverse), MAGENTRA_STRLOC macro with BUILD_UNINSTALLER pass guards. .github/workflows/release.yml — windows leg uploads app/dist/*.exe and latest.yml. app/main.js — no-sandbox switch when PORTABLE_EXECUTABLE_FILE is set.

TEST CHECKLIST
1. package.json build.win.target is exactly ['portable', 'nsis'], portable.artifactName is 'MAGENTRA-${version}-win-portable.exe' and nsis.artifactName is 'MAGENTRA-${version}-win-setup.exe' with oneClick false.
2. bundle-engine.js --target win fails with a message naming `npm run fetch:rg-win` when node_modules/@vscode/ripgrep-win32-x64/bin/rg.exe is missing; when present, build-resources/engine/rg.exe exists and is listed in build.win.extraResources.filter.
3. After `npm run dist`, app/dist contains both MAGENTRA-<package.json version>-win-portable.exe and MAGENTRA-<version>-win-setup.exe plus latest.yml, matching the release workflow's upload glob.
4. installer.nsh defines customInstall and customUnInstall, references build/magentra.cmd, and wraps the magentraStrLoc function insertion in !ifndef BUILD_UNINSTALLER / !ifdef BUILD_UNINSTALLER guards (so each compile pass defines exactly one variant).
5. updates.js assetName on win32 produces the same two names as the package.json artifactName patterns for the running version.
